title: Small RL Controller, Large Language Model: RL-Guided Adaptive Sampling for Test-Time Scaling
authors_zh: Runpeng Dai、Tong Zheng、Rui Liu、Chengsong Huang、Hongtu Zhu（机构：北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校、马里兰大学帕克分校、圣路易斯华盛顿大学）
paper_type_zh: 强化学习引导的自适应测试时采样研究
best_for_zh: 设计成本敏感的停止策略与并行采样策略的推理系统研究者。
one_line: RL-Guided Sampling trains a small CPU-deployable policy to stop or expand parallel reasoning samples under explicit cost penalties.
RL-Guided Sampling 用可在 CPU 部署的小型策略网络，决定何时停止或追加并行推理样本。
why: It turns a hand-written sampling budget rule into a learned, auditable decision policy whose quality, latency, and sample costs are measured together.
inclusion_reason: It learns an explicit policy for allocating extra samples and rounds at inference time under joint correctness, latency, and compute objectives.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Fixed-budget self-consistency spends the same amount of inference computation on an easy problem and a hard one. Adaptive baselines reduce some waste, but commonly stop with a hand-written threshold or a distributional assumption. Those rules can either keep sampling after the answer distribution has already settled or stop while a useful correction is still likely, and sequential decisions can add latency even when many candidates can be produced in parallel.

This paper asks whether the allocation itself can be learned as a sequential control problem. The target is a small controller that sees only the final answers already sampled from a fixed reasoning model, decides whether to stop or request more parallel answers, and explicitly trades final-answer quality against both the number of candidates and the number of sampling rounds.

固定预算的自一致性会为简单题和困难题投入相同的推理计算。自适应基线虽然能减少部分浪费，却通常依赖手写阈值或分布假设来停止。这些规则可能在答案分布已经稳定后继续采样，也可能在仍有希望得到有效修正时过早停止；而逐次作出决策还会在本可并行生成多个候选时增加延迟。

本文研究能否把预算分配本身学习为一个序贯控制问题。目标是训练一个小型控制器：它只观察固定推理模型已经采到的最终答案，决定停止还是请求更多并行答案，并且显式权衡最终答案质量、候选数量和采样轮数这三类代价。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central idea is to make adaptive sampling a finite-horizon Markov decision process rather than a confidence heuristic. The controller’s state summarizes the observed answer pool through the top answer-count classes, the number of candidates already drawn, and answer-distribution entropy. Its action is either to terminate and return the current majority answer or to obtain a small parallel batch of additional candidates.

Correctness is not optimized alone. Continuing receives separate penalties for another sampling round and for every new candidate, while stopping receives a terminal reward based on the majority answer that the same run would produce at its fixed sample limit. A four-layer MLP trained with PPO therefore learns a cost-sensitive stopping rule without reading hidden states, logits, prompt semantics, or intermediate chain-of-thought text.

核心思想是把自适应采样建模为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，而不是置信度启发式规则。控制器的状态通过最高频答案类别、已抽取候选数和答案分布熵来概括当前答案池。它的动作要么是终止并返回当前多数答案，要么是再获取一个小的并行候选批次。

优化目标并不只包含正确率。继续采样会分别承担一次新采样轮次和每个新候选的惩罚；停止时则根据同一次运行在固定样本上限下会得到的多数答案获得终止奖励。因此，用 PPO 训练的四层 MLP 能学习成本敏感的停止规则，而无需读取隐藏状态、logit、提示语义或中间思维链文本。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each question, the authors first prepare an offline pool of 128 model responses and form a controller trajectory by sampling up to 32 of them. At round t, the state contains the top five answer frequencies, the current number of candidates, and entropy. The controller chooses stop, or asks for one, two, or four additional responses in parallel. Stopping returns a majority vote; an episode also ends when the candidate cap is reached.

The reward combines a positive or negative terminal outcome with stepwise penalties for latency and computation. The default terminal target is the running majority that would result after continuing to the 32-sample limit, rather than the benchmark’s ground-truth label; this deliberately aligns the reward with answer-pool statistics available to the controller. The paper trains the policy using PPO on 200 DAPO questions, then evaluates Qwen3 variants and GPT-4.1-nano on AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25 against fixed self-consistency, Adaptive Self-Consistency, and Early-Stopping Consistency.

对于每个问题，作者先准备一个含 128 个模型回答的离线池，再从中最多抽取 32 个回答形成控制器轨迹。在第 t 轮，状态包含最高频的五个答案计数、当前候选数和熵。控制器选择停止，或并行请求一、二或四个额外回答。停止时返回多数投票；达到候选上限时，一个回合也会结束。

奖励把正负终止结果与延迟和计算的逐步惩罚结合起来。默认终止目标是继续采样到 32 个样本上限时会形成的运行中多数答案，而不是基准的真实标签；这样做是为了让奖励与控制器可观察到的答案池统计量保持一致。论文用 200 个 DAPO 问题通过 PPO 训练策略，再在 AIME24、AIME25 和 HMMT25 上，以多种 Qwen3 与 GPT-4.1-nano 同固定自一致性、Adaptive Self-Consistency 和 Early-Stopping Consistency 比较。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The principal evidence is a three-benchmark comparison across four samplers. On Qwen3-4B-Instruct-Thinking, the controller keeps the average accuracy at 54.6%, essentially matching 54.8% for 32-sample self-consistency, while using 10.9 samples and 2.8 rounds on average. Under the paper’s default configurations, this is fewer samples and rounds than both Adaptive Self-Consistency and Early-Stopping Consistency at nearly unchanged accuracy.

The paper also tests whether the controller learns a portable allocation signal rather than a model-specific threshold. A policy trained from Qwen3-0.6B samples transfers to GPT-4.1-nano and Qwen3-4B-Instruct scaling curves. In a reward ablation on Qwen3-4B-Instruct, the running-majority target attains 54.6% average accuracy with 10.9 samples, whereas substituting the real label lowers accuracy to 53.7% and increases average consumption to 17.0 samples; this supports the claimed match between the state representation and reward target.

核心证据是跨四种采样器和三个基准的比较。在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-Thinking 上，控制器的平均准确率为 54.6%，与 32 样本自一致性的 54.8% 基本相同，但平均只用 10.9 个样本和 2.8 轮。在论文默认配置下，它以几乎不变的准确率，比 Adaptive Self-Consistency 和 Early-Stopping Consistency 都使用更少样本和轮次。

论文还检验控制器学到的是可迁移的分配信号，而非某个模型专属阈值。用 Qwen3-0.6B 样本训练的策略能迁移到 GPT-4.1-nano 和 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 的扩展曲线。在 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 的奖励消融中，运行中多数目标以 10.9 个样本得到 54.6% 平均准确率；改用真实标签则将准确率降至 53.7%，并把平均消耗增至 17.0 个样本，这支持了状态表示应与奖励目标相匹配的主张。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier adaptive self-consistency methods use posterior thresholds, fixed chunks, or other designed stopping rules. This work changes the decision object: instead of asking a heuristic whether the present answer distribution looks settled, it learns a policy over answer-pool statistics, explicit sampling actions, and a reward that prices both latency and candidate count. The Lagrangian interpretation makes the policy’s two penalties legible as relaxed resource constraints rather than incidental tuning coefficients.

The contribution is not a new reasoning generator or a richer verifier. Its distinctive unit is the lightweight controller placed outside an unchanged sampler, and the evidence concerns the accuracy–rounds–samples frontier produced by that controller. Before reuse, readers should verify how final answers are extracted, whether majority voting is valid for the target task, how offline response pools were generated, and whether wall-clock cost follows the same relation as the paper’s sample and round proxies.

较早的自适应自一致性方法使用后验阈值、固定分块或其他人工设计的停止规则。本文改变了决策对象：它不再让启发式规则判断当前答案分布是否稳定，而是在答案池统计量、明确的采样动作和同时为延迟与候选数定价的奖励上学习策略。拉格朗日解释使两类惩罚可以被理解为放松后的资源约束，而不是偶然的调参系数。

贡献不在于新的推理生成器或更丰富的验证器。它的独特单元是放在不变采样器外部的轻量控制器，证据也围绕该控制器形成的准确率、轮数和样本数前沿展开。复用前应核验最终答案的提取方式、多数投票是否适用于目标任务、离线回答池如何生成，以及实际墙钟成本是否与论文使用的样本数和轮数代理保持同样关系。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The controller is trained and evaluated on mathematical-answer tasks where a final answer can be counted and majority voting is meaningful; its state deliberately ignores prompt semantics, reasoning quality, hidden states, and answer confidence. The terminal reward is a surrogate based on the 32-sample running majority, not direct task correctness, so it can preserve a stable but wrong consensus. The reported cost objective is also expressed through samples and rounds, while real latency depends on model serving, batching, extraction failures, and hardware. A deployment should therefore measure wall-clock behavior, inspect wrong but highly consistent answers, and retune or retrain the policy when its answer distribution changes.
控制器在可统计最终答案且多数投票有意义的数学题上训练和评测；它的状态有意忽略提示语义、推理质量、隐藏状态和答案置信度。终止奖励是基于 32 样本运行中多数的代理，而不是直接的任务正确性，因此可能维持稳定但错误的共识。报告中的成本目标也以样本数和轮数表示，实际延迟却取决于模型服务、批处理、答案提取失败和硬件。部署时应测量墙钟行为，检查高度一致却错误的答案，并在答案分布变化后重新调参或训练策略。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when a reasoning service already samples several complete solutions but needs a policy for deciding whether another parallel batch is worth its cost. Its state/action/reward decomposition is a practical template: expose only answer-pool statistics, make stop and batch sizes explicit actions, and report accuracy, total samples, rounds, total tokens, and sequential tokens together. The official code is the starting point for reproducing the controller, but production reuse should replace its offline candidate-pool assumption with the serving stack’s real sampling and latency measurements.
当一个推理服务已经会采样多个完整解答，却需要判断另一个并行批次是否值得其成本时，可以使用这篇论文。它的状态、动作和奖励分解提供了实用模板：只暴露答案池统计量，把停止和批量大小设为明确动作，并同时报告准确率、总样本数、轮数、总 token 和顺序 token。官方代码可作为复现控制器的起点，但生产复用应以服务栈真实的采样和延迟测量替换其离线候选池假设。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Remember four points. First, the model being sampled remains fixed; learning happens in a separate four-layer controller. Second, the controller sees final-answer frequencies and entropy rather than token-level internals. Third, its action space controls both whether to continue and how many responses to add in parallel, so latency is a first-class target rather than an afterthought. Fourth, the strongest empirical claim is a better accuracy–cost frontier against ASC and ESC on math benchmarks, not a proof that majority-based adaptive sampling works for every reasoning domain.
记住四点。第一，被采样的模型保持不变，学习发生在独立的四层控制器中。第二，控制器看到的是最终答案频率和熵，而非 token 级内部信息。第三，它的动作空间同时控制是否继续以及并行增加多少回答，因此延迟是第一等目标，而非事后考虑。第四，最强的实证主张是在数学基准上相对 ASC 和 ESC 得到更好的准确率—成本前沿，而不是证明基于多数投票的自适应采样适用于所有推理领域。
